head: The Canadiens are on a heater
paras: The Penguins won the first meeting this season, 6-5 in overtime in Pittsburgh. The Canadiens have won four straight. The Pens are 5-6-2.
At home, Martin St. Louis likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Penguins’ first line. The Penguins make their shots count, and the Canadiens allow dangerous ones.

items.text: The Penguins are newly without Bryan Rust, and have been without Trevor van Riemsdyk since Oct 9.
The Canadiens are newly without Mike Matheson, and have been without Nick Suzuki, Samuel Montembeault and Ivan Demidov for several games. Jacob Fowler is expected to start.
Phillip Danault is set to play his 800th NHL game.
Chris Kreider has six goals in nine games against Pittsburgh since 2023-24, most of them with the Rangers.

MTL.head: Anybody’s game
MTL.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though Montréal has home-ice advantage, the Canadiens will be without Suzuki, and Pittsburgh gets Solovyov back. The Canadiens can tip it if they get good looks.

PIT.head: A genuine toss-up
PIT.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Even though Montréal has home-ice advantage, Pittsburgh gets Solovyov back, and the Canadiens will be without Suzuki. The Penguins can tip it if they get good looks.

calls.head: A tough night ahead for Crosby
calls.body: At home, the Canadiens keep sending Dobson and Hutson out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Martin St. Louis has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Penguins’ first line is Novak, Crosby and Rakell.

calls.head: No wasted shots for the Penguins
calls.body: When the Penguins shoot, it’s usually a real chance, and the Canadiens are one of the league’s worst at stopping that. Jacob Fowler is going to be busy in all the wrong ways.
